name: request_security_htf_capture
script:
indicator("Request HTF Capture", overlay=True)
higher_close = request.security("BTCUSDT", "240", "close")
higher_gapped = request.security("BTCUSDT", "240", "close", gaps=barmerge.gaps_on)
higher_ahead = request.security("BTCUSDT", "240", "close", lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)
previous_close = request.security("BTCUSDT", "240", close[1])
requested_open, requested_high, requested_low = request.security(
    "BTCUSDT",
    "240",
    lambda ctx: (ctx.open, ctx.high, ctx.low),
    gaps=barmerge.gaps_on,
)
provider_time, provider_open, provider_high, provider_low, provider_close, provider_volume = request.security(
    "BTCUSDT",
    "240",
    ("time", "open", "high", "low", "close", "volume"),
    gaps=barmerge.gaps_on,
)
plot(higher_close, "HTF Close")
plot(higher_gapped, "HTF Close Gapped")
plot(higher_ahead, "HTF Close Lookahead")
plot(previous_close, "HTF Previous Close")
plot(requested_open, "HTF Requested Open")
plot(requested_high, "HTF Requested High")
plot(requested_low, "HTF Requested Low")
plot(provider_time, "HTF Time")
plot(provider_open, "HTF Open")
plot(provider_high, "HTF High")
plot(provider_low, "HTF Low")
plot(provider_close, "HTF Provider Close")
plot(provider_volume, "HTF Volume")

//@version=5
_pyne_capture_bars = 12
_pyne_capture_use_last_bars = input.bool(true, "Pyne capture: use last chart bars")
_pyne_capture_start_time = input.int(1704067200000, "Pyne capture: start time (ms)")
_pyne_capture_start_hit = time >= _pyne_capture_start_time and (na(time[1]) or time[1] < _pyne_capture_start_time)
_pyne_capture_from_time = ta.barssince(_pyne_capture_start_hit)
_pyne_capture_from_last = bar_index - (last_bar_index - _pyne_capture_bars)
_pyne_capture_index = _pyne_capture_use_last_bars ? _pyne_capture_from_last : _pyne_capture_from_time
_pyne_capture_active = _pyne_capture_index >= 0 and _pyne_capture_index < _pyne_capture_bars
indicator("Pyne Request Capture - HTF Alignment", overlay=true)
plot(_pyne_capture_active ? _pyne_capture_index : na, "Pyne Capture Index")
